name: docs-standards
description: Standards, a production process and an audit workflow for high-quality technical documentation and for explanations given in chat: derive every claim (with the hardware's non-ideal terms), define before use (notation tables with code names, symbols decoded where they appear, the kind of every product named, informal labels built before they are used, every tool and command said what it is at its first use in each chapter), one running numeric example carrying the whole argument (the product's own case, never a toy, in a document about a product), illustrate concepts, keep it self-contained, open every stage and chapter with what and why, show every artefact you name, generate numbers and cross-references, point by name or anchor and never by an invented label, propagate corrections, no dashes as connectives, no status labels in titles, a bare title page and nominal headings, fix systematically, and verify visuals. Sentence rules (one idea, at most 40 words, no semicolon, the noun in the sentence, no code identifier standing in for an idea, no count nobody uses) and a register of plain sentences with real counts. A process: the heading tree approved first and frozen, one writer for the whole text, fresh outsider readers per chapter who know none of the stack, one audience read of the whole document with a verdict per criterion, bounded verification with the owner's yes before any sweep, one delivery with verdicts. Adds the writing-technical-docs skill (with a Ukrainian engineering-prose reference and the two reader briefs), the reporting-experiments skill (the shape of a measurement or comparison report: derived conditions, the measurement ceiling, calibrated metrics, controls before mechanisms, what the test does not show, reproduction, defect ledgers, records with their commit and run times), the typesetting-documents-as-pdf skill (with check_section_refs.py, check_sentences.py, check_word_gaps.py, the silent-glyph fault and the checks a long document grows: loose lines, breaks inside what the reader copies, stranded lead-ins, empty page feet, references by name numbered by the toolchain, citations that resolve, attachments by hash), the documenting-existing-designs skill (provenance-tiered analysis reports, audited block diagrams, verification against real artefacts with coverage accounting, a «Not verified» list), the designing-research-studies skill (research design documents: hypotheses with refutation criteria, candidate sieve with thresholds, checkpoints, an evaluation protocol with splits by record, condition bands, seeds and validation-chosen operating points, budget and order of cuts, rulings and handoffs), the writing-research-reports skill (theses and R&D reports: chapters written from artefacts in order, the introduction paragraph by paragraph, a review chapter closed by gap and hypotheses tables, methods sufficient for reproduction, results by condition band with the sieve reported, register and terminology of the genre, a literature review protocol and a pre-submission checklist), and a /review-doc command that runs the outsider read first and the audience read last.
